Gaggan Anand

Asia's most daring progressive Indian tasting menu

Bangkok/Restaurants/Gaggan Anand

About

Chef Gaggan Anand's eponymous restaurant serves one of Asia's most talked-about tasting menus — playful, emoji-decoded progressive Indian cuisine. Consistently ranked among the world's best restaurants; reservations essential.
